title: Dated G-sec (IN0020230085) sold on the exchange after ~14 months in Mar-2025: listed security convention, LT 12.5 % under s.112, no s.112A exemption
rules: ISIN prefix IN00 -> Government of India dated security (not equity, not a fund unit) -> 'other' non-equity security

Convention adopted: a G-sec is treated as a security listed on a recognised stock exchange for Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso (12-month rule). View: defensible - G-secs are 'securities' under SCRA s.2(h) and are admitted to trading on NSE/BSE (retail G-sec / NDS-OM access); but primary trading is on RBI's NDS-OM, not a recognised stock exchange, so a 24-month reading is arguable
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: LTCG on transfer on/after 23-Jul-2024 at 12.5 % without indexation
s.112A applies only to STT-paid equity shares / equity-oriented fund units / business-trust units -> no Rs 1.25 lakh exemption for a G-sec
s.50AA (unlisted bonds/debentures, market-linked debentures) not applicable under the listed convention
derivation: Sale on exchange 2025-03-20: 100 @ 101.20 -> proceeds 10,120.00 (clean price; accrued interest ignored).
Held 2024-01-10 -> 2025-03-20 (about 14 months > 12; listed convention) -> long; transfer after 23-Jul-2024 -> 12.5 %.
Alternative (G-sec not 'listed'): 14 months <= 24 -> short at slab: tax 51.00, cess 2.04, total 53.04 (s.50AA, if it reached a G-sec as an 'unlisted bond', would give the same slab result).
